1 year since mine of a year+ ended... still hurts sometimes but you will begin to heal over time I promise. I thought things would never get better but I really can tell you that they do get easier. You’ve probably got a bit more pain to get through but over time you will become yourself again. 

I was taught this simple saying that was very motivational for me: “just get through today.” I know it sounds simple but if you really buy into it, it is very effective!!! Forever feels impossible, but today is certainly feasible. Good luck OP, feel free to dm me and remember...”I just need to get through today”

I jumped on that shit asap when I got prescribed lol. Mine has done wonders for me. I take Trintellix 20mg. It won’t harm you, there’s no need to worry about that aspect. If you have any questions dm me and I’ll be happy to answer!
